summary.intent: Resolve a trail finding (callisto/211) after pushing a fix for --dry-run handling, then start step 3: update the Changesets differential test to assert that `init` now writes the fixed group into callisto.toml.
summary.outcome: Finding resolved with a note referencing commit 74f8dc735. A new worktree and branch wp-differential-assert-init was created, the ignored real-Changesets differential test was changed to assert `[[fixed-group]]` with npm/alpha and npm/beta in callisto.toml, and it passed. Lint, commit, merge of origin/main and push were run in the last command, but its output (lint result, push success) isn't shown in the transcript.

repo: Real Changesets differential tests live in crates/callisto-cli/tests/release_verify_real.rs and are #[ignore]d; they need network and real @changesets/cli installs.

Running them needs @changesets/cli@3.0.3 installed under target/verify-real/npm and @changesets/cli@2.31.1 under target/verify-real/changesets-2, with PATH including the first's node_modules/.bin and VERIFY_REAL_CHANGESETS_2 pointing at the second's changeset binary.
The tests are run with `cargo test -p callisto-cli --test release_verify_real <name> -- --ignored --test-threads=1`, with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 to limit load.
`callisto init` (crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/init/changesets.rs) now carries the Changesets `fixed` group into callisto.toml as [[fixed-group]] rather than only warning about it.
Worktrees are created under .claude/worktrees/<branch> off origin/main; `just lint` is the lint entry point.
The `entire` CLI provides `trail finding resolve <repo/PR> <id> -m <msg>` for resolving review findings, and `entire agent-help` for usage.

code.finding: The a_changesets_fixed_group differential test previously parsed init's JSON report for a 'warned about fixed' flag; it now reads callisto.toml and asserts it contains [[fixed-group]], npm/alpha and npm/beta.

workflow: Verify the pushed commit's signature via `gh api repos/.../commits/<sha> --jq .commit.verification.reason` before resolving findings.
Doing an in-place Python string-slice edit via heredoc was used for a multi-line test replacement.
Fresh worktrees lack target/verify-real, so the npm tooling must be reinstalled per worktree.

friction: The fresh worktree had no installed Changesets CLIs, requiring two npm installs before the ignored test could run.
Several `entire` subcommands had to be probed with --help to find the right resolve syntax.
open_items: Confirm the final command's results (lint pass, merge of origin/main, push of wp-differential-assert-init) since output wasn't shown.
Open a PR or trail entry for the wp-differential-assert-init branch if not already done.
